title: Stuffed Zucchini
description: from Yoko, especially for Zanti. Simple, yet tasty. From Joy of Cooking. Ingredients: 2 medium zucchini (I used one big one and two small ones) 2 tsp olive oil 3 Tbs onions, finely chopped 1 clove garlic, minced 1 egg, beaten 1/2 C grated cheese (Parmesan or similar type) 1/3 C dry unseasoned bread crumbs* 2 Tbs fresh parsley, chopped 2 tsp fresh basil, tarragon, marjoram, or thyme, chopped (I used basil) 1/2 tsp lemon zest (I omitted this) salt and pepper *Alternatively, you can use Italian seasoned bread crumbs and omit the cheese and herbs. Directions: Halve zucchini lengthwise. Scoop out the pulp, leaving 3/8-inch shell. Save the pulp-- squeeze to get rid of excess moisture. Steam the shells for about 5 minutes. Don't overcook. Heat olive oil in a skillet, saute garlic and onion until soft. Add zucchini pulp. Put mixture into a bowl and add egg, breadcrumbs, cheese and herbs. Spoon this filling into shells and set into baking dish. Drizzle tops with a little olive oil. Bake at 400 degrees for about 30 minutes, until tops are browned and slightly crispy.
